wikipedia.title: Social Democratic Party of Switzerland
wikipedia.extract: The Social Democratic Party of Switzerland, also called the Swiss Socialist Party, is a political party in Switzerland. The SP has had two representatives on the Federal Council since 1960 and received the second-highest number of votes in the 2023 Swiss federal election.

note: The record is a press article about the Association of Young Social Democrats (VJS), and the primary source dossier HB-VJS (P1) directly pertains to this youth organization within the Swiss Social Democratic movement.
